repos_data.description: Verifies & compiles reduced-motion-safe, on-budget UI animation for AI-generated web apps. Validated specs → deterministic GSAP/WAAPI-CSS; WCAG 2.2.2 + 2.3.3 checks. MIT core + keyless MCP server. Not Motion.dev/Framer Motion, not the Android/iOS MotionSpec classes, not a video generator.

MCP server with 40 tools for web design analysis — layout extraction, motion detection, quality scoring, accessibility audit, Core Web Vitals, design comparison, and semantic search via Playwright, pgvector, ONNX Runtime, and Ollama.

Eyes for AI coding agents: deterministic MCP server that tells the LLM which CSS rule wins, in which file, on which line — and why. Cascade verdicts, blast radius, interaction timelines, pixel-perfect audits.

Triage for AI-generated code review: grades each changed diff line green/yellow/orange by impact, so reviewers spend attention where it matters. High-signal, low-noise (0 false blocks), deterministic — in your coding agent (MCP), editor (VS Code), and CLI/CI.
Capture a logged-in browser task once — replay it forever at zero LLM tokens. Local-first browser-automation MCP for Claude Code, Cursor & any MCP host; credentials never leave your machine.
Claude Code plugin — AI-powered autopilot for managing open source contributions. Track PRs, respond to maintainers, discover issues, maintain velocity.
Mine your Claude Code and Codex logs into a local you.md agent profile.
Quickly screenshots webpages and converts to an LLM friendly size
Agent-native UI/UX design validation via MCP — journey completeness, state coverage, WCAG checks before code exists

Analytics MCP server for Clamp Analytics. Gives Claude, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, and Cline tools for traffic, pages, events, revenue, errors, funnels, cohorts, and alerts. Stdio + hosted Remote MCP.
The design layer for agentic AI — design context, interface checks, and verification for coding agents.

repo_meta_data.description: Catch bad animations before they ship. Deterministic motion audit + vision-LLM design review for your terminal and Claude Code.
